scripts.dev:tauri: pnpm run build:navigator:dev && vite build && node scripts/check-product-separation.mjs && node scripts/check-browser-ipc-disabled.mjs && vite
scripts.build: pnpm run build:navigator && pnpm run typecheck && vite build && node scripts/check-product-separation.mjs && node scripts/check-browser-ipc-disabled.mjs
scripts.build:fixture-runner: pnpm run typecheck && vite build --mode fixture-runner --outDir dist-fixture-runner && node scripts/check-browser-ipc-disabled.mjs
scripts.build:fixture-runner:linux: node scripts/tauri-pinned.mjs --cargo-target-dir=target/fixture-runner build --config src-tauri/tauri.fixture-runner.conf.json --features fixture-runner --bundles deb
scripts.qualify:fixture-runner:desktop: node scripts/tauri-pinned.mjs --cargo-target-dir=target/fixture-runner build --debug --no-bundle --config src-tauri/tauri.fixture-runner.conf.json --features fixture-runner && node scripts/collect-fixture-runner-desktop.mjs
scripts.qualify:native-browser:linux: pnpm run build && cargo build --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --target x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu && pnpm run test:native
scripts.qualify:durable-storage:linux-native: node scripts/tauri-pinned.mjs --cargo-target-dir=target/fixture-runner build --debug --no-bundle --config src-tauri/tauri.fixture-runner.conf.json --features fixture-runner && node scripts/collect-native-durable-storage-linux.mjs
scripts.lint: oxlint --type-aware src tests scripts playwright.config.ts vite.config.ts vitest.config.ts
scripts.format: oxfmt --write src tests scripts playwright.config.ts vite.config.ts vitest.config.ts
scripts.format:check: oxfmt --check src tests scripts playwright.config.ts vite.config.ts vitest.config.ts
scripts.check: pnpm run format:check && pnpm run lint && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run test && pnpm run check:compiler && pnpm run build && pnpm run check:dev-server
scripts.android:dev: pnpm build && node scripts/tauri-pinned.mjs android dev --no-watch --no-dev-server --config '{"build":{"beforeDevCommand":"","devUrl":null}}'
